items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: And Charlie Buchanan used to tickle me, he says now you got a good band

ctx.x: I bet old Charlie Buchanan nearly died, because he was always in the back of it all, wasn't he.

Yeah, Charlie Buchanan, well, you know, he was running the Savoy for them, you know what I mean. And Charlie Buchanan used to tickle me, he says now you got a good band, they like your band here, but it's the raggiest band I ever seen in my life.
